title: Add RAG agent examples, RAG templates, and docs site quickstarts
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a set of reproducible RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent examples and RAG template quickstarts to the repo and updates the docs site with guided walkthroughs. Motivation: provide engineers and platform integrators with end-to-end examples for tool-calling agents that combine the Redwood streaming API, vector store retrieval, and structured output templates. Changes include: 1) new examples under examples/agents/rag with Dockerfile and local-run scripts, 2) RAG templates and eval prompts under examples/rag-templates, 3) docs site pages and short tutorial notebooks under docs/site/content/quickstarts/rag-agent, 4) CI job to run lightweight smoke tests for examples and docs preview, 5) small SDK usage snippets in docs to demonstrate tool-calling and function responses. Checklist: [x] examples added and smoke-tested locally [x] docs pages authored and rendered in local site build [x] reviewers addressed feedback and updated wording for template variables [x] CI checks passing before merge. Preview: docs site local build link included in PR description and a public docs-preview was generated by the docs pipeline for QA. Related PRs: pr-19512 (earlier RAG quickstart), pr-19168 (agent tooling changes).

release_notes: Added RAG agent quickstarts and example templates for tool-calling agents. New docs pages with step-by-step tutorial and a runnable Docker-based example. No API breaking changes.
notes: Docs preview URL: https://preview-redwood-docs.example.com/quickstarts/rag-agent. The examples include small sample vector data and instructions to connect to an S3-backed vector store or in-memory fallback for local testing.
safety_and_privacy_notes: Examples avoid shipping real customer data; README stresses using restricted keys and local vector data. Added KMS note for Private deployments.
